theorem extendBy_nodes_getElem_right (p : ℕ) (hp : p < ns.length) :
    (γ.extendBy es ns).nodes[γ.nodes.length + p]'(by rw [extendBy_nodes_length]; omega) = ns[p] := by
  simp only [extendBy]
  rw [List.getElem_append_right (by omega)]
  congr 1
  omega
